_about: The single source of truth for QUILL's third-party notices.

Every bundled or redistributed third-party component of every QUILL family product is one entry in `components`. quill/tools/build_third_party_notices.py renders docs/legal/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and .txt from this file, and each installer app's standalone/<app>/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and LICENSE.txt; its --check mode (and tests/unit/tools/test_third_party_notices.py) fails when a rendered file has drifted, or when a Python distribution in a build inventory has no entry here.

Python versions and licences were read from installed package metadata (py -3.14, 2026-10-26). `--versions` compares them with what is installed now; it reports and does not fail, because the release build, not this file, decides what ships.

`products` is a list of product keys, or ["all"]. Every installed app uses the shared QuillVille Runtime, whose dependency set is the union of the app requirements, so a library in that runtime is included by each installer that carries it. Standalone portable editions use app-specific dependency groups and inventories; do not infer their contents from the shared runtime. `delivery` is bundled, shared-runtime, on-request (downloaded from QUILL's own pinned release when the person asks for it, so we still redistribute it), or build-only (never shipped). `review` marks an entry whose licence or terms could not be confirmed, or which carries an obligation the owner should decide on.

groups.title: Family components
groups.intro: Libraries written by Community Access and Blind Information Technology Solutions (BITS) for the QUILL family and published separately. They are listed so that every package in a build has an entry; they are not third-party.

groups.title: Runtime and libraries
groups.intro: Python itself and libraries shipped in the shared runtime or an app's own dependency set. Installed apps share the runtime; portable editions carry only the dependencies selected for that product.

groups.title: Audio and video
groups.intro: Separate programs and engines for playing, recording and converting media.

groups.title: Speech and dictation
groups.intro: Speech engines, voices and recognition models.

groups.title: Data and dictionaries
groups.intro: Word lists, dictionaries, directories and other data files.

groups.title: Fonts, sounds and icons
groups.intro: No fonts are bundled: every app uses the fonts Windows already has. The sounds and icons are listed here.

groups.title: Build-time only
groups.intro: Used to build or test the family and never shipped to you. Listed for completeness; their licences place no obligation on the products.

components.review: Decision recorded: retain PyMuPDF under AGPL-3.0 and preserve existing PDF behavior. The installed QuillVille Runtime includes PyMuPDF; installed app editions carry it through that runtime. QUILL's GLOW feature uses it; QUILL's ordinary PDF reader uses pdfplumber and pypdf, with pypdfium2 for scanned-page rendering. Current standalone portable dependency groups omit the GLOW extra, and the committed portable inventories omit pymupdf; verify staged portable artifacts independently. The exact 1.28.2 source archive and checksum are listed above. Legal review is required before the next public release to determine whether QUILL's shared runtime and application packages form a covered combined work, the Corresponding Source scope, and whether section 13 applies to any modified network-facing covered work. This entry does not declare all original QUILL code relicensed under AGPL; the MIT boundary and any exceptions need counsel's review.

components.name: GitHub Copilot CLI runtime (copilot-runtime.exe, runtime.node)
components.license_label: GitHub Copilot CLI License (proprietary; redistribution of unmodified copies permitted)
components.what: The engine behind the My GitHub Copilot connection, run as a separate program: the runtime bundle the GitHub Copilot SDK installs for itself, taken from GitHub's github-copilot-1.0.105-win32-x64 package. Ships unmodified in the shared runtime's tools\copilot with its licence as COPILOT-CLI-LICENSE.txt. The bundle also carries components GitHub ships inside it -- Microsoft's sign-in libraries (OneAuthInterop.dll, with its licence as OneAuthInterop.LICENSE.txt, and msalruntime.dll), and Microsoft's tgrep -- each signed by GitHub or Microsoft and covered by that licence -- and ripgrep, which has its own entry.

components.name: ripgrep (rg.exe)
components.what: A fast text search program the GitHub Copilot CLI runtime carries in tools\copilot\ripgrep, shipped inside GitHub's package unmodified. Its licence texts are LICENSE-MIT (SHA-256 0f96a83840e146e43c0ec96a22ec1f392e0680e6c1226e6f3ba87e0740af850f) and UNLICENSE (SHA-256 7e12e5df4bae12cb21581ba157ced20e1986a0508dd10d0e8a4ab9a4cf94e85c) at ripgrep tag 15.0.0, the version the bundled rg.exe reports.

components.name: OpenAI Codex app-server (codex-app-server.exe)
components.what: The Codex agent engine, run as a separate program. Ships unmodified, signed by OpenAI, in the shared runtime's tools\codex with its licence as CODEX-LICENSE.txt and its NOTICE as CODEX-NOTICE.txt.

components.name: FFmpeg (ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers. FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard.
components.what: Records, converts and inspects audio and video. Run as a separate, unmodified program. LICENSE.GPLv3.txt and README-SOURCE.txt (the source offer) ship beside every ffmpeg.exe; scripts/check_ffmpeg_notices.py fails a build otherwise.
components.obligations: Ship the GPL-3.0 text and the corresponding source or a written offer. Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz, and the README-SOURCE.txt beside the program. Because it runs as a separate program, our own code is not affected.

components.name: libmpv (libmpv-2.dll)
components.license_label: GPL-3.0 as built (mpv itself is GPL-2.0-or-later; the bundled FFmpeg inside it is GPL)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) the mpv developers; Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
components.what: The playback engine: recording-while-playing, output-device routing, volume boost and stream titles. Its licence texts and source offer ship beside the DLL in tools\mpv.
components.review: libmpv is loaded into the same process as the app. A GPL library loaded in-process makes the combined program subject to the GPL when distributed. QUILL's own source is public under MIT, which is GPL-compatible, so this is satisfiable, but the obligation (offer the complete source of the combined program) should be acknowledged by the owner.

components.name: OptiLab Core
components.license_label: Apache-2.0 with the Commons Clause License Condition v1.0
components.copyright: Copyright 2026 Lanes Audio (OptiLab Core, by dgl1984)
components.what: Broadcast-style sound polishing (Podcast Leveler, Stream Polish, Smooth Limiter). The engine is compiled into quill-optilab.exe; the live-playback modes are ffmpeg filter chains adapted from it. Its LICENSE and NOTICE ship beside the program as OptiLabCore-LICENSE.txt and OptiLabCore-NOTICE.txt.
components.review: The Commons Clause forbids selling the software. QUILL is free and never sold, and the upstream NOTICE grants royalty-free use for producing and streaming audio, so this fits today; it would block any paid edition.

components.name: TG Drop Deck (adapted code)
components.what: Studio's sound capture adapts two small pieces of Tony Gebhard's live-show deck: the check that a captured program is still running, and listing sound devices one at a time so one bad name cannot empty the list. Several other capture fixes follow lessons TG Drop Deck published.

components.name: DECtalk
components.copyright: Originally Digital Equipment Corporation; later Fonix Corporation and others
components.what: The classic DECtalk voices, supported only when installed separately by the user. QUILL does not distribute the runtime or DECtalk voice previews.
components.review: Redistribution rights are not established. Do not redistribute DECtalk or its voice samples without written permission from the rights holder. Previously published builds must be reviewed separately.

components.name: Dictation models: Moonshine tiny (English), Whisper tiny.en and tiny (ONNX), Silero VAD
components.version: sherpa-onnx conversions, SHA-256 pinned in quill/core/windows_dictation/engines.py
components.license_label: MIT (each model); converted and distributed by the sherpa-onnx project (Apache-2.0)
components.copyright: Moonshine: Copyright (c) 2024 Useful Sensors; Whisper: Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI; Silero VAD: Copyright (c) 2020-present Silero Team
components.what: Offline dictation. A NOTICE file beside the models names each one and its licence.

components.name: eSpeak NG
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 2005-2026 Jonathan Duddington, Reece H. Dunn and contributors
components.what: A compact speech synthesiser, and the phoneme source for Piper and Kokoro. Run as a separate program or library.
components.obligations: Ship the GPL-3.0 text and the corresponding source or a written offer (upstream source for 1.52.0: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng/releases/tag/1.52.0).

components.name: Kokoro-82M voices and kokoro-onnx
components.license_label: Apache-2.0 (Kokoro model); MIT (kokoro-onnx and ONNX Runtime); GPL-3.0 (phonemizer and eSpeak NG runtime/data)
components.copyright: Kokoro: Copyright hexgrad; kokoro-onnx: Copyright thewh1teagle; ONNX Runtime: Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
components.what: Natural-sounding offline neural voices. The model is bundled in the QUILL Offline Edition's optional component and QUILL Studio's portable edition, otherwise downloaded on request; Voice Previews has Kokoro samples.
components.review: The locked Kokoro runtime includes GPL-3.0 phonemizer and eSpeak NG components. Confirm the staged engine pack carries their source/licence notices and exact versions before release.

components.name: MathCAT
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Neil Soiffer and the DAISY Consortium
components.what: Speaks and brailles mathematics. Downloaded on request from QUILL's release.

components.name: NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming, English 0.6B (int8)
components.what: An optional offline English dictation model, downloaded when you choose it in Manage Speech Models. Its NOTICE.txt travels with it.

components.name: Piper text-to-speech engine
components.what: A fast offline neural voice. Bundled in QUILL Studio's portable edition; otherwise downloaded on request. Piper uses eSpeak NG's phoneme data.

components.name: Piper voices
components.license_label: Varies by voice (each voice's MODEL_CARD names its dataset and licence; several are CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0 or MIT, and some datasets restrict commercial use)
components.copyright: Each voice's trainer and dataset owner
components.what: Voices for Piper, downloaded on request, and the short Piper samples in Voice Previews.
components.review: Not confirmed voice by voice. QUILL redistributes some voices (from its own release) and ships samples of 39 of them in quill/data/voice-previews/piper. Each voice's MODEL_CARD must be checked and its licence and attribution recorded here.

components.name: Vosk small English model (vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15)
components.what: The recognition model Vosk uses, staged beside the app.

components.name: Vosk speech recognition (with Kaldi)
components.copyright: Copyright 2019-2026 Alpha Cephei Inc.; Kaldi: Copyright Johns Hopkins University and others
components.what: Offline speech recognition: QUILL Cast's chapter finder and an optional dictation engine in QUILL.

components.name: Whisper models (GGML format)
components.version: tiny (bundled in Offline Editions); others on request
components.what: Speech recognition models for whisper.cpp.

components.name: whisper.cpp
components.what: The default offline transcription engine. Bundled in the Offline Editions and QUILL Studio's portable edition; otherwise downloaded on request.

components.name: Emoji catalog (Unicode emoji-test.txt, CLDR annotations, iamcal/emoji-data)
components.license_label: Unicode License v3 (Unicode and CLDR data); MIT (iamcal/emoji-data)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 1991-2026 Unicode, Inc.; emoji-data: Copyright (c) 2013 Cal Henderson
components.what: Names, groups and search words for the emoji picker.

components.name: English thesaurus (th_en_US_v2, MyThes format)
components.license_label: GPL-2.0, per the licence file that ships with it (quill/data/th_en_US_LICENSE.txt)
components.copyright: Copyright Kevin B. Hendricks and the OpenOffice.org / LibreOffice thesaurus contributors; WordNet data Copyright Princeton University
components.what: Synonyms for the thesaurus. Every build ships quill/data, so every product carries it.

components.name: Hunspell dictionaries
components.version: English set bundled with PyEnchant; others from LibreOffice dictionaries at commit 93d537d
components.license_label: Per language. The downloadable languages (es_ES, fr_FR and others) are GPL-3.0, LGPL-3.0 or MPL-2.0 as their own README states; each zip carries those files.
components.copyright: Each dictionary's authors (for English: Kevin Atkinson's SCOWL and contributors; for Spanish: RLA-ES; for French: Dicollecte)
components.what: Spelling dictionaries for QUILL's spell checker.
components.review: The English dictionaries that ship inside PyEnchant's payload (en_US, en_GB, en_AU and other en_* variants) were not checked one by one; their README files are not in the pruned payload. Confirm and keep their licence files with them.

components.name: liblouis (QUILL Braille Pack)
components.license_label: LGPL-2.1-or-later (library); the translation tables carry their own licences, and the pack ships COPYING (GPL-3.0) and COPYING.LESSER
components.copyright: Copyright (C) the liblouis project contributors (ViewPlus Technologies, JJB Software, and others)
components.what: Braille translation and back-translation. An optional component; its licence texts and source ship inside the pack.

components.name: NOAA weather radio and forecast directory
components.copyright: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)
components.what: Weather office and NOAA Weather Radio data for Quill Weather and Quill Radio.

components.name: Radio station catalog seed
components.license_label: Radio Browser directory data (public domain); Project Gutenberg catalog records; Wikidata (CC0-1.0)
components.copyright: Radio Browser community; Project Gutenberg contributors; Wikidata contributors
components.what: A starting directory of stations and audio books, so searching works offline on first launch. It ships in quill/data, so every product carries it.

components.name: Voice Previews (synthesised samples)
components.license_label: Generated by QUILL from the voices named in each sample; the terms follow each voice
components.copyright: Samples made by the QUILL project with Piper, Kokoro, eSpeak NG and Windows SAPI 5 voices
components.what: Short recordings so you can hear a voice before downloading it.
components.review: Voice models trained on restricted datasets may limit use of their output. Confirm each remaining voice's terms alongside the Piper voice entries.

components.name: WordNet 2.1
components.copyright: Copyright 2005 by Princeton University. All rights reserved.
components.what: The lexical database behind the thesaurus. Licence in quill/data/th_en_US_WordNet_LICENSE.txt.

components.name: words_alpha (dwyl/english-words)
components.copyright: Dedicated to the public domain by the dwyl/english-words contributors
components.what: An English word list, used for word completion and checks.

components.name: Image Description Toolkit (ideas and image prompt text)
components.what: Kelly Ford's batch image-description tool. The twelve image prompt styles in quill/core/ai/vision_prompts.py come from it, and QUILL Studio's Describe a Folder, Describe Again, photo details as context and Save Described Copies follow its approach and its choice of metadata fields. No code is copied.

components.name: App icons
components.what: Every app's icon, drawn by scripts/build_app_icons.py. No third-party artwork.

components.name: Page-turn sound (quill/assets/audio/page_turn.wav)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Blind Information Technology Solutions (BITS); Copyright (c) 2026 Jeff Bishop
components.what: An original synthesized page-turn-like default sound between chapters in spoken audiobooks; no sampled audio is used.

components.name: QUILL sound packs (Ink and the indent-tone packs)
components.what: Interface sounds, synthesised by scripts/gen_ink_sounds.py and scripts/gen_indent_tones.py. No third-party recordings.

components.name: Weather alert sound (quill/assets/audio/weather_alert.wav)
components.what: The weather alert tone, synthesised by scripts/gen_ink_sounds.py.

components.name: Inno Setup
components.license_label: Inno Setup licence (free, permissive; modified-BSD style)
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 1997-2026 Jordan Russell and Martijn Laan
components.what: Build-time installer engine. The compiler is not shipped, but Inno Setup code is embedded in the Windows Setup.exe files.
components.review: The full licence is included in the family notices. Confirm a built Setup.exe retains the upstream copyright and website strings after compiler upgrades.

components.name: Pandoc (documentation build)
components.what: Renders the user guides to HTML and EPUB. The rendered guides are QUILL's own text.

components.name: PyInstaller
components.license_label: GPL-2.0-or-later with the PyInstaller bootloader exception (programs it builds may ship under any licence)
components.what: Freezes the QuillVille Runtime and some app editions. Its bootloader is inside QuillVilleRuntime.exe under the bootloader exception.

components.name: Test and lint tools (pytest, ruff, mypy and their plugins)
components.what: Run the test suite and the code gates.
